event: A scraping sound occurs, and the task is to determine its location (left, right, or back) relative to a virtual robot standing by the fireplace and facing the rectangular dining table.

sounding_object.description: Kitchen sink on the island. The scraping sound originates from a man (wearing a green shirt and blue jeans) scraping a black frying pan with a black spatula in this stainless steel sink, which is part of a kitchen island with a white countertop and dark wood base.

reference_object.description: A stone fireplace with a mantelpiece, located against a wall in the living room area, to the left side of the main living space when viewed from the kitchen/dining area.

facing_object.description: A wooden rectangular dining table with chairs, located in the dining area near large windows, between the kitchen island and the windows.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the fireplace and facing the rectangular dining table, when the scraping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
